title: Adding with regrouping: 27 + 15
examples: What does carrying mean in addition?

explain.say: Kofi has 27 marbles. He gets 15 more. How many does he have now? Look at the blocks. 27 is on top, and 15 is below.
Always start with the ones. 7 ones and 5 ones make 12 ones. 12 is too many for the ones place. You can make a ten from them.
Swap 10 ones for 1 ten rod. This is called regrouping. 12 ones becomes 1 ten and 2 ones. The new rod goes with the tens.
Now add the tens. 2 tens and 1 ten make 3 tens. Add the new ten, and you have 4 tens. 4 tens and 2 ones make 42. So 27 plus 15 equals 42.
In columns, write a small 1 above the tens. It reminds you of the new ten. People call this carrying. Try 38 plus 46. Then check the board. It shows 84.

faq.a: Regrouping means swapping 10 ones for 1 ten, or 1 ten for 10 ones. The amount stays the same; it is just packed differently.

faq.q: What does carrying mean in addition?
faq.a: When the ones add up to 10 or more, you carry the new ten into the tens column. You write a small 1 above the tens to remember it.

faq.q: Why do we start adding from the ones?
faq.a: Because the ones might make a new ten that has to move into the tens column. If you start with the tens, you may have to go back and fix them.
asks: Why not add the tens first?

faq.a: Add the ones: 7 plus 5 is 12, so write 2 and carry 1 ten. Add the tens: 2 plus 1 plus the carried 1 is 4. The answer is 42.

faq.q: When do I need to regroup?
faq.a: Only when a column adds up to 10 or more. 23 plus 14 needs no regrouping, because 3 plus 4 is only 7.
asks: Do I always need to carry?

facts: Regrouping works because 10 ones are worth exactly 1 ten.

quiz.say: Look at the 3 sums. Which sum needs regrouping?
quiz.why: 6 and 8 make 14 ones. That is more than 9, so you regroup.

wrong.1: 1 and 5 make 6 ones. 6 fits in the ones place.
wrong.2: 2 and 4 make 6 ones. 6 fits in the ones place.

quiz.say: Add 46 plus 37. Start with the ones.
quiz.why: 6 and 7 make 13, so write 3 and carry 1. Then 4 and 3 and 1 make 8 tens, so the answer is 83.

wrong.0: 73 leaves out the carried ten. Add it to the tens.
wrong.2: 713 puts 13 in the ones place. Swap 10 ones for 1 ten first.
